name: goodmem-work
description: Your team's memory in ChatGPT: recall past decisions, notes, and documents, and save conversations worth keeping.

interface.shortDescription: Recall what your team already knows, and keep what matters
interface.longDescription: GoodMem gives ChatGPT access to your team's own knowledge. Ask a question and it recalls the relevant decisions, notes, and documents you have stored, with sources. Share a document and it remembers the contents so you can search them later. Ask it to save a conversation and it keeps the exchange as question-and-answer pairs in a space you can name. Connect your GoodMem account to get started.
